verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents item statuses (Active, Resolved, Muted, Archived), which cover resolve and ignore/mute, and lets a specific user be designated as an item's Owner. The evidence does not show a snooze/time-boxed mute or automatic reopening of resolved items when they regress, so roughly half the story is evidenced. missing for 10: snooze capability, automatic reopen-on-regression of resolved items, independent or hands-on corroboration of the triage workflow.
